motions.info_slide_plain:
Under a "Mandatory Development Zoning" policy, land in high demand urban areas
must be developed to its maximum zoning density potential (within a reasonable
period). Land owners who meet the requirements are given tax benefits, while
those who do not face penalties such as fines or even forfeiture (confiscation
of land assets by the authorities).

motions.info_slide_plain:
Kibbutzim were Israeli collective communities historically based on shared
ownership of assets, collective labour, communal decision-making, and
relatively equal distribution of income among members. From the 1980s onwards,
many kibbutzim underwent privatisation. This involved shifting away from equal
communal wages toward differential salaries, assigning members individual
responsibility for household expenses, introducing market-based employment
arrangements, and restructuring kibbutz-owned enterprises along more
conventional corporate lines.
motions.text: This House supports the privatisation of Kibbutzim
motions.info_slide: Kibbutzim were Israeli collective communities historically based on shared ownership of assets, collective labour, communal decision-making, and relatively equal distribution of income among members. From the 1980s onwards, many kibbutzim underwent privatisation.
